# Kin Form

> Form state that stays out of your way. A framework-agnostic form-state
> engine (`@kintools/form-core`) with React bindings (`@kintools/form-react`), typed
> nested field paths, and per-node or whole-tree validation.

Kin Form models a form as a tree: every node, from a single input to a nested
group or array to the form itself, is the same `FieldApi` class. Reusable
field/group/array components, type-safe dot-path field access
(`form.field("address.line1")`), and declarative cross-field validation all
follow from that one idea.

## Packages

- [@kintools/form-core](https://jsr.io/@kintools/form-core): the framework-agnostic
  engine, `FieldApi`/`FormApi`, zero runtime dependencies
- [@kintools/form-react](https://jsr.io/@kintools/form-react): React bindings,
  `useForm`/`useWatch`/`Watch`/`useMultistep`
- [@kintools/form-validators](https://jsr.io/@kintools/form-validators): validator
  factories plus `toSchemaValidator()` for zod/valibot and other Standard
  Schema libraries
- [@kintools/form-devtools-react](https://jsr.io/@kintools/form-devtools-react): a
  dev-only inspector panel for a form's live tree state
